name: qwen35-4b-aesthetic-scorer
source: Lora-SFT tower_head, commit 50b05fa6a1b1fd0cd564c494de9b9f9bd32fa84f: Qwen3.5-4B's vision tower, frozen, with aesthetic and technical heads trained on EVA (https://github.com/zhongwater123/A-NAS/issues/480)
memoryNote: Measured with the bundle's own code on a development machine, PyTorch fp32 on the CPU: about 1.7 GB once loaded and 1.9 GB at the peak of a 640 x 480 photo; a 512 px thumbnail takes no more (#480). To be measured in the Worker's cgroup on the NAS.
license: The Qwen3.5-4B vision tower is under Apache-2.0 (licenses/Qwen3.5-4B-LICENSE.txt). The scoring heads were trained on EVA. The EVA authors dedicate their annotations under CC0-1.0 (https://github.com/kang-gnak/eva-dataset/blob/master/LICENSE). The training photographs come from AVA and have third-party rights holders. The model author confirmed internal evaluation only; external distribution of the trained heads, including commercial distribution, awaits legal review (https://github.com/zhongwater123/A-NAS/pull/504#issuecomment-7121478394). Dataset reference: Chen Kang, Giuseppe Valenzise and Frédéric Dufaux, EVA: An Explainable Visual Aesthetics Dataset, ATQAM/MAST 2020, https://doi.org/10.1145/3423268.3423590.
